topic: patch a large doorknob-sized hole in drywall
core_question: How do you repair a large hole in drywall, like one punched by a doorknob? (secondary: How do I fix a toilet that wobbles or rocks when you sit on it?)
answer_summary: Cover the hole with a self-adhesive mesh or metal patch, apply joint compound over it in thin coats, sand smooth, then prime and paint.; after the topic shift: Remove the toilet, scrape off the old wax ring, shim the base level against the floor flange with plastic shims, install a new wax ring, and reset and bolt down the toilet.
